title: Satellite Weather Trends: Russia Expands Elektro-L Fleet
description: Recent reports highlight Russia's expansion of its weather satellite capabilities, sparking interest in satellite weather data.

sections.heading: Russian Satellite Expansion
paragraphs: According to www1.ru, Russia is expanding its Elektro-L satellite constellation. The source also reports that the Elektro-L No. 5 satellite is now in service, which has expanded the Russian orbital group.

sections.heading: Completion of Weather Fleet
paragraphs: Tech Times reports that Russia has completed its geostationary weather fleet. This achievement was noted to have occurred despite space-grade export controls, according to Tech Times.
